description: This file defines interfaces related to warning reporting, including warning events, reporting units, and control mechanisms within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for warning event objects, providing methods for serialization, deserialization, categorization, and warning identification.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface for warning reporting units, managing warning events and categories, including reporting, category management, and control.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit::IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Nested interface for controlling warning reporting categories, allowing enabling/disabling and configuration.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Method to report a warning event with specific details such as identifier, file name, line number, class name, and event information.

methods.name: IsDefaultCategory
methods.description: Checks if a category is default, returning its enabled state and configuration.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Announces a warning reporting category for monitoring or configuration.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a previously announced warning reporting category.
